posts.headline: Tyrique14 struts in with a ring, but the Thicks' career record is a pedestrian 14-14 — that's not a dynasty, that's a coin flip that got lucky once.
posts.detail: One title in two seasons with an average finish of 5.5 means #FreeMaxx Champions have exactly one great month to their name. Defend it or admit the crown was a fluke.

posts.headline: Put it in Ra has the resume of a champion — 20-8, back-to-back top-2 finishes — and ZERO rings to show for it, which makes One Nut Barner the most disrespected contender in Busters Anonymous.
posts.detail: A .714 win percentage and an average finish of 1.5 with no title is basically the Buffalo Bills of fantasy football. Adam Barner, all that pedigree means nothing until there's hardware.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh finished dead last at 4-10 with an average finish of 12 — and Chauncey shows up to this draft like he's got something to prove.
posts.detail: There is no bigger basement-dweller in this league than a 12th place finish out of 12 teams. Prove-it szn starts now, but the receipts say don't bet on it.

posts.headline: Championshipsovercoochie is exactly what the nickname says — a fraud, dead-center average finish of 4th, never better, never worse, forever mid.
posts.detail: mjwithgoldhoops has posted a suspiciously identical 4th place finish both seasons — the African Bald Fraud's ceiling and floor are the same number, and that's not consistency, that's a plateau.

posts.headline: SwooshAnoosh's lone season ended at 11th place with a 5-9 record — the Prince of Persia rules over nothing but the cellar.
posts.detail: A .357 win percentage in year one isn't a rebuild, it's a warning label. This draft better look nothing like the last one or it's another season in the desert.
